summary: Clean, fair and easy: everyone knows these countries, and Russia counting as Asian gives one bit of debate. Works as a gentle daily list, and suits Blitz slightly better.
reasons: Casual found all 10 with 2 lives lost (South Korea #14, Thailand #12); the fan lost one on Turkey (#11). Near misses are exactly the kind you learn from.
Curve leans easy: 8 answers come almost automatically, with Russia (counted whole as Asian) and Iran as the late finds. Fine for a light day, not a challenge.
Blitz has a 50-deep pool of countries anyone can name; a casual 90 s run scored 18 of 18.
fixes: Source dataAsOf shows the build date; the figures are UN 2023 estimates, so set dataAsOf to 2023.
Hong Kong and Macau are not rows of the source table but cost a life as accepted answers; make them free (or rank them by population) so a reasonable guess is not punished without a rank.
